answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments bind each agent's stake to a verifiable delay primitive, forcing any identity clone to recompute a sequential proof whose cost exceeds the staking collateral; slashing penalties proportional to proof deviation make the expected attack utility negative, establishing a robust Nash equilibrium.
